composition: central black panel with disc-corner anchors
description: Collaged mixed-media composition on a dark ground featuring multiple compact discs arranged at corners and along the bottom edge, their iridescent surfaces reflecting blue, green, and gold. Vertical pink and lavender strips descend through the center above a frieze of small discs, perforated borders, printed text fragments, and handwritten numerals reading 'xxxiii d17.'
title: Black Box, Iridescent Discs
